info.title: v2.logistics.upload_serviceable_polygon
info.description: Only available for Brazil sellers. Use this API to upload KML file for shop level serviceability setting for BR Entrega Turbo channel (Channel ID: 90026). Please note that multiple Outlet Shops under the same Mart Shop cannot have overlapping service areas.

post.description: Only available for Brazil sellers. Use this API to upload KML file for shop level serviceability setting for BR Entrega Turbo channel (Channel ID: 90026). Please note that multiple Outlet Shops under the same Mart Shop cannot have overlapping service areas.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The .kml file to be uploaded to denote the serviceability area of the shops. Note: Please refer to “KML file format for v2.logistics.upload_serviceable_polygon” to understand the structure specifications and upload requirements for KML files.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/upload_polygon?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => array('file'=> new CURLFILE('/path/to/file') /* Replace with actual file path */),
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: multipart/form-data'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

curl --location --request POST 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/upload_polygon?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp' \
--form 'file=@"/path/to/file"'  #replace the sample path with your file path
